points: Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
steps.title: Garlic Time

points: Pour the boiled water from your kettle into a large saucepan with 1/2 tsp salt on high heat.
Add the rigatoni to the water and bring back to the boil. Cook until tender, 12 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a colander and pop back in the pan. Drizzle with oil and stir through to stop it sticking together.
steps.title: Get the Pasta on

points: Meanwhile, heat a large frying pan on medium-high heat (no oil).
Once hot, add the beef mince and fry until browned, 5-6 mins.
Use a spoon to break up the mince as it cooks, then drain and discard any excess fat. Season with salt and pepper.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw mince. It's cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Fry the Beef

points: Add the garlic and chipotle paste (add less if you'd prefer things milder) to the beef. Stir-fry for 1 min.
Stir through the passata, beef stock paste, sugar and water for the sauce (see pantry for both amounts).
Simmer until the sauce has thickened, 5-6 mins.
steps.title: Add the Flavour

points: Once the sauce has thickened, add the spinach to the pan a handful at a time until wilted and piping hot, 1-2 mins.
Stir through the cooked pasta and three quarters of the grated cheese.
Add a splash of water if it's a little thick.
steps.title: Cheese Please

points: When ready, share your chipotle beef rigatoni between your bowls.
Sprinkle over the remaining cheese to finish.
steps.title: Serve
